prompt: Scan source text to decide which classes are runnable, ignoring main methods that are commented out. Complete MainClassScanner and run the tests.
explanation: Normalising text before searching it is the trick that makes this tractable: once line comments are gone and every run of whitespace is one space, a declaration split across lines looks exactly like a one-line declaration. replaceAll with the regex \\s+ does the whitespace collapsing in a single call. findMainClasses then reduces to filter, rename, sort -- and sorting the result makes the output independent of the map's iteration order.
hints: Handle the two clean-up steps in a private helper so isRunnable stays readable.
For each line, indexOf("//") tells you where the comment starts; keep only the text before it.
After joining the lines back together, text.replaceAll("\\s+", " ") collapses newlines and runs of spaces into single spaces so a wrapped declaration matches.
